name: BudgetBee
summary: A smart personal finance platform that helps users track daily expenses, manage receipts, create monthly budgets, and gain actionable insights into spending habits through interactive dashboards and visual reports.
overview: BudgetBee enables users to record day-to-day transactions, store receipts digitally, and organize expenses across categories such as Food, Travel, Entertainment, Education, Shopping, and Utilities.
The platform provides complete visibility into monthly budgets and spending patterns, helping users control expenses, improve financial planning, and make informed money management decisions.
technicalOverview: The application was developed using modern frontend technologies to provide a fast, responsive, and intuitive user experience across desktop and mobile devices.
Core functionality includes budget planning, expense categorization, transaction tracking, month-wise reporting, category-based analysis, and real-time financial calculations.
Interactive charts and visual dashboards offer users meaningful insights into their spending behavior, making it easier to monitor financial goals and optimize budgets.

name: Thymos
summary: A healthcare management ecosystem for providers and patients, covering appointments, patient records, prescriptions, reports, schedules, secure communication, EHR integration, and real-time notifications.
overview: Thymos streamlines collaboration between healthcare providers and patients through a unified web and mobile ecosystem.

The platform enables healthcare professionals to manage appointments, patient records, prescriptions, schedules, medical reports, and operational workflows while giving patients convenient access to healthcare services and medical information.
A Slack-based chatbot supports real-time communication, appointment notifications, operational support, and better care coordination.
technicalOverview: The platform was developed using Spring Boot and PostgreSQL to provide a scalable, secure, and high-performance healthcare solution.
JWT-based authentication was used for secure access control, while integrations with healthcare and communication services supported real-time collaboration and operational workflows.
The system integrates with Oyster HR EHR, AWS Chime, AWS SNS, and Slack APIs for secure healthcare data management, communications, notification delivery, and chatbot-driven interactions.

name: FaithConnect
summary: A faith-based community engagement platform that connects church members through events, social groups, real-time communication, community feeds, business directories, and personalized notifications.
overview: FaithConnect was developed to strengthen relationships and communication within church communities and faith-based organizations.
The platform enables members to create profiles, discover church events, participate in community groups, share updates, and engage with fellow members through an interactive social experience.
It serves as a centralized hub for community engagement, event coordination, content sharing, and meaningful connections among church members.
technicalOverview: FaithConnect was built as a cross-platform mobile application using React Native, providing a seamless experience across both iOS and Android devices.
The platform leverages Google Cloud Platform services to ensure scalability, reliability, and secure data management.

Google Cloud Functions manage backend services, Google Pub/Sub handles asynchronous event processing, Redux powers application state management, Temporal orchestrates workflows, and Jest ensures application quality through automated testing.
features: Mobile number-based registration and secure authentication
Church member profile creation and management
Church event planning and participation management
Community feed for announcements and updates
Cross-platform support for iOS and Android
Automated testing and quality assurance with Jest

name: Cartiva
summary: A headless ecommerce and rewards platform with product catalog management, BigCommerce integration, reward points, returns, refunds, content management, SEO, and analytics.
overview: Cartiva delivers a seamless online shopping experience while giving businesses tools for product management, customer engagement, and sales growth.
Customers can browse products, make purchases, earn reward points, redeem benefits, manage accounts, and handle returns or refunds through a responsive interface.
The solution uses a headless commerce approach to combine flexible content management with scalable ecommerce capabilities.
technicalOverview: The platform was developed using Next.js and NestJS with a headless architecture for speed, scalability, SEO, and flexible content operations.
BigCommerce acts as the commerce engine for product management, inventory synchronization, order processing, and pricing management.

A Headless CMS allows content teams to update website content independently, while SEO improvements include dynamic sitemap generation and optimized rendering. Google Analytics and third-party integrations support customer journey and conversion tracking.
features: Dynamic content management through Headless CMS
Reward points and loyalty management system

name: RestroStaff
summary: A serverless restaurant workforce management platform for staff onboarding, employee assignments, training programs, quizzes, scheduling, announcements, tasks, and operational compliance.
overview: RestroStaff optimizes restaurant operations by managing staff, training programs, communication, and daily activities across multiple restaurant locations.
Administrators can add, update, remove, and assign employees while ensuring staff remain aligned with training and operational procedures.
The platform centralizes employee management, training delivery, task scheduling, and internal communication to improve workforce productivity and service consistency.
technicalOverview: The system was built with a serverless cloud architecture powered by AWS services for scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient operations.
Node.js and AWS Lambda handle business logic, user management, training workflows, scheduling, and content delivery without dedicated server infrastructure.

AWS API Gateway exposes secure REST APIs, Amazon Cognito manages authentication and access control, PostgreSQL stores operational data, Amazon S3 stores media assets, and CloudWatch provides logging and monitoring.

name: Hooplive Stats
summary: An innovative tournament management platform that replaces paper score sheets with dynamic scoreboards, live WebSockets updates, scheduling tools, and player profile databases.
overview: Hooplive Stats is a comprehensive basketball tournament management system that streamlines scheduling, team management, and match updates.
The software eliminates manual calculations and data entry errors, providing fans and league admins with an online live scoring portal.
technicalOverview: Built with a React JS frontend and Node JS/Express backend backend to coordinate high-frequency match metrics.
Integrates WebSockets (Socket.io) for real-time live score updates, Sequelize ORM for MySQL db interactions, and JWT tokens for secure authentication.
features: User Authentication and Roles & Notification System

name: Advance Health Academy
originalContext: Personalized Health Insights & Biomarker Analysis Portal
summary: A clinical insights application that standardizes blood test metrics, extracts diagnostic markers using image processing, and generates organ workload reports with secure sharing.
overview: Advance Health Academy is a comprehensive medical application designed to empower users with personalized insights into their health through automated blood test analysis.
The platform parses test reports to highlight potential organ abnormalities, helping patients proactively coordinate care with their healthcare providers.
technicalOverview: Uses Python-based AWS Lambda functions and image processing algorithms to parse scanned blood test reports into structured data.
Implements unit standardization on the backend to reconcile variations in clinical metrics across different countries.
Integrates Amazon SES for secure clinical profile email delivery, Stripe for payment handling, and Dynamo DB for health records.
features: Secure Profile Sharing via Amazon SES

name: MoveMint
summary: A fitness rewards mobile application that integrates with Google Fit and Apple Health to convert daily physical activity into reward points, enabling users to participate in challenges, earn incentives, and unlock exclusive benefits.
overview: MoveMint is a fitness engagement platform designed to encourage healthier lifestyles through gamification and reward-based motivation.
Users can track daily steps, earn reward points, join community and corporate fitness challenges, compete on leaderboards, and redeem rewards from partnered merchants.
technicalOverview: Developed as a cross-platform mobile application using React Native, Redux-thunk, and TypeScript to deliver a seamless user experience across iOS and Android devices.
The platform integrates with Google Fit and Apple Health to securely synchronize fitness activity data, enabling accurate step tracking, challenge participation, and reward calculations in real time.

name: Property Listing
originalContext: Real Estate Rental Analysis & Property Management Portal
category: Real Estate Rental Analysis & Property Management Portal
summary: A comprehensive real estate analytics and property management platform that helps investors, buyers, and property managers evaluate rental opportunities, analyze market trends, and make data-driven investment decisions.
overview: Property Listing enables users to discover real estate opportunities across multiple cities while analyzing property values, rental income potential, and investment performance.

The platform supports detailed analysis of single-family and multi-family properties, helping users compare rental yields, occupancy potential, and investment returns through advanced filtering and reporting tools.
technicalOverview: Built using React JS and Core UI to deliver an interactive and responsive user experience for property discovery and investment analysis.

The platform utilizes a Node.js backend with Sequelize ORM for efficient data management and integrates advanced visualization tools to present market trends, pricing insights, and rental performance metrics.
Interactive dashboards and analytics reports help investors evaluate opportunities and monitor property portfolios with actionable real-time insights.

name: MetricVoice
summary: A customer experience and feedback intelligence platform that transforms survey responses into actionable insights through engagement-driven data collection, analytics dashboards, and enterprise reporting.
overview: MetricVoice empowers organizations to collect, analyze, and act on customer feedback through structured survey engagements and framework-based data analysis.
The platform transforms responses into meaningful visual insights, helping businesses improve customer satisfaction, employee engagement, and strategic decision-making.
Role-based access controls ensure secure collaboration between administrators, members, and guests across the organization.
technicalOverview: Built using React.js and Material UI on the frontend, with Node.js and NestJS powering scalable backend services.
An API Gateway architecture centralizes service communication while Elastic Search delivers high-performance querying across large volumes of survey and engagement data.
Interactive reporting and visualization capabilities are powered by ECharts, providing real-time analytics and trend analysis.
features: Admin, Member, and Guest role management

name: Gamora
summary: A gaming application integrating Web3 MetaMask wallets, allowing gamers to use digital tokens for deposits, withdrawals, and tracking token yields.
overview: Gamora connects cryptocurrency assets with casual gaming to provide a rewarding user experience.
Integrates MetaMask, tracks match metrics, and generates notifications for updates and token claim timelines.
technicalOverview: Built with a Next.js and Redux frontend and a Node.js backend managing account and match details.
Integrates MetaMask SDK extensions for secure transaction signatures, Yup for validations, and Chart.js for progress records.

name: Bloomify
originalContext: E-commerce Plants Ordering & Real-Time Tracking Portal
summary: A modern online nursery and plant delivery platform that enables customers to discover, purchase, and track plants while providing administrators with powerful inventory, pricing, and catalog management capabilities.
overview: Bloomify allows customers to browse a wide range of indoor plants, outdoor plants, gardening products, and seasonal collections through an intuitive e-commerce experience.

The platform provides real-time order tracking, promotional campaigns, personalized product discovery, and a comprehensive administration portal for inventory management, pricing updates, and catalog maintenance.
technicalOverview: Built using React.js and Next.js to deliver a fast, SEO-optimized shopping experience with server-side rendering and improved search engine visibility.
The platform leverages Node.js and MySQL to manage products, orders, inventory, customer accounts, and delivery workflows efficiently.
Additional optimizations include prerendering strategies for organic search performance, automated catalog synchronization, and security validation using industry-standard scanning tools.

name: CityPulse
originalContext: Urban Facilities & Service Request Management Portal
category: Urban Facilities & Service Request Management Portal
summary: A centralized urban operations and workforce management platform that streamlines service requests, facility maintenance, carpool coordination, procurement tracking, payroll management, and administrative workflows.
overview: CityPulse was developed to modernize urban operations by providing a unified platform for managing facility services, workforce activities, and administrative processes.

The platform enables employees and operational teams to submit service requests, coordinate transportation, manage purchase records, track payroll information, and monitor facility-related activities through an intuitive interface.
By centralizing operational workflows, CityPulse improves response times, increases transparency, and enhances collaboration across departments and city service teams.
technicalOverview: The platform was built using React JS and Kendo UI to deliver responsive dashboards, dynamic forms, advanced data grids, and efficient administrative workflows.
A Java-based backend powers business operations and integrates with a MySQL database to securely manage requests, employee records, facility data, and operational transactions.
REST APIs facilitate seamless communication between frontend and backend systems while supporting real-time updates and scalable service management processes.

name: FamilyVest
originalContext: Multi-Role Wealth Management & Portfolio Analytics Platform
category: Family Wealth Management & Portfolio Analytics Platform
summary: A comprehensive family wealth management platform that enables households, family members, and financial advisors to track investments, monitor assets, analyze portfolio performance, and manage financial goals through role-based access and analytics dashboards.
overview: FamilyVest provides a centralized platform for managing family wealth, allowing Heads of Household, Family Members, and Financial Advisors to securely access and manage financial portfolios.
The platform enables household heads to monitor aggregated family assets, switch between member portfolios, review investment performance, and gain real-time visibility into overall financial health.
technicalOverview: Built with React.js for interactive dashboards and portfolio visualization, delivering a responsive user experience across devices.
The backend leverages ASP.NET and SQL Server to securely manage financial transactions, portfolio data, user permissions, and advisor workflows.
Role-based access control, credential encryption, and third-party financial integrations ensure secure management of investment data and real-time portfolio analytics.

name: RentBridge
summary: A multi-portal rental assistance platform that streamlines emergency housing support by connecting applicants, landlords, and administrators through secure workflows, document verification, and payment processing.
overview: RentBridge simplifies the emergency rental assistance process by providing a centralized platform for applicants, landlords, and program administrators.
The system manages the complete assistance lifecycle, including application submissions, document verification, lease validation, landlord collaboration, payment approvals, and fund distribution.
By consolidating multiple user portals into a unified platform, RentBridge improves transparency, reduces processing time, and enhances communication between all stakeholders.
technicalOverview: The platform was developed using React JS for a responsive user experience and Node.js with MySQL for secure and scalable backend operations.
Document management workflows support lease verification, applicant eligibility validation, landlord documentation review, and case tracking.
Integrated payment processing and administrative workflows ensure efficient assistance distribution while maintaining compliance and auditability.
features: Applicant registration and assistance application workflows
Landlord portal and rental ledger management
Multi-portal architecture for different user roles

name: Vestora
originalContext: Stock Asset Management & Charitable Giving Platform
category: Stock Asset Management & Charitable Giving Platform
summary: A stock management and charitable giving platform enabling users to track investment portfolios, automate tax receipt generation, and donate stock assets directly through GraphQL-powered services.
overview: Vestora combines modern portfolio management with seamless charitable giving capabilities.
Investors, advisors, and heads of households can monitor stock performance, manage risk profiles, and maximize tax-efficient donations.
The platform streamlines stock-based philanthropy while providing comprehensive asset tracking and reporting tools.
technicalOverview: Built using React and TypeScript with GraphQL powering communication across frontend and backend services.
Apollo API Gateway orchestrates requests across multiple microservices, ensuring scalability, performance, and efficient data aggregation.
The microservice architecture enables independent deployment, simplified maintenance, and optimized portfolio and donation workflows.
